requirements.category: I. Young Author Sovereignty & Creative Freedom
requirements.title: Creator-First Constitutional Law
requirements.requirement: The fourteen-year-old writer owns the creative decisions within every story; the assistant is a critic, researcher, and optional collaborator, not the default coauthor.
requirements.acceptance: Reject a workflow that silently replaces a protagonist, ending, or world rule without affirmative author choice.
